title: Insert an IT company in the middle
description:
Insert an IT company in the middle of the companies list.

Python-Gym adaptation: implement as insert_company_middle(companies, company), returning a new list with company inserted at index len(companies) // 2.
hints: Lists have a method for inserting a value at a specific index without overwriting anything.
Compute the middle index the same way as for reading the middle item: len(companies) // 2.
Copy companies, then call updated.insert(len(updated) // 2, company).
expected_behavior: Returns a new list with company inserted at the middle index.
solution:
def insert_company_middle(companies, company):
    updated = companies.copy()
    updated.insert(len(updated) // 2, company)
    return updated
explanation: list.insert(index, value) shifts everything from index onward to the right and places value at that position; len(companies) // 2 is the middle position.
